hooks.name: custom_payload_from_client
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge registers payload handlers per type; Bukkit's PluginMessageListener)

rust_summary: a player's plugin channel message on a channel that isn't Horizon's own (`native_custom_payload_from_client`).
doc_summary: `native_custom_payload_from_client(player, channel, data)` hears a player's `ServerboundCustomPayloadPacket` in play on any channel that isn't Horizon's own, which vanilla drops: in the tick after it arrives, with no player's state swapped in, from a dead player too. Bundles need "hooks": @API:custom_payload_from_client@.
